name: Le Meridien Lav, Split
positioning: Le Méridien Lav, Split: a beachfront resort in Podstrana, just outside Split, with its own long beach, marina and spa on the Dalmatian coast
best_for: Travelers who want a beach and marina resort near Split
Active guests who want tennis, boating and island excursions

facts.text: The hotel is in Podstrana, on the coast just outside Split, Croatia.
Every guest room and suite has floor-to-ceiling windows opening onto a large balcony.
The Presidential Suite has a private balcony with a panoramic view of the Adriatic Sea and nearby islands.
The RE:CUPERA spa has steam baths and saunas, treatment rooms, an indoor pool and a fitness area.
The spa offers Asian massage styles including Thai, Balinese, Lomi-Lomi, reflexology, shiatsu and Ayurveda.
The fitness centre overlooks the Adriatic Sea.
There are four tennis courts with lights and a hardcourt surface of the kind used on the ATP Tour.
The hotel has beachside cabanas along the shoreline.
The Thrills & Chills adventure agency arranges excursions such as boat tours to nearby islands, national park outings, cliff jumping and canyoning.
Breakfast at Spalatum Restaurant is a buffet, served inside or on a terrace with views of the Adriatic Sea and the city of Split.
Gooshter Beach Club serves street food with flavours from the East and South in an informal setting.

highlights.text: The hotel has an 800-metre stretch of beach with sea views toward the city of Split and the surrounding islands.
The hotel has its own marina, where guests can book a berth.
The hotel's yacht, the Lav Boat, takes guests on tours of the Adriatic coast and nearby islands from the hotel marina.
The hotel has an outdoor infinity pool.
The Terrace Suite has a large terrace with a private Jacuzzi.

considerations.text: Split Airport is about 16 miles from the hotel.
Gooshter Beach Club is open during the summer.
Guest rooms do not have a fridge.
